mapper.select: SELECT doctor_id AS doctorId, payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM patient_video_diagnosis WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT vd.id AS diagnoseId, pc.name AS name, pc.tel AS tel, pu.photo AS photo, DATE_FORMAT(vd.expect_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expectStart, DATE_FORMAT(vd.expect_end, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expectEnd, vd.status AS status FROM patient_video_diagnosis vd JOIN patient_user_info pc ON vd.patient_card_id = pc.id JOIN patient_user pu ON pc.user_id = pu.id WHERE vd.id = #{diagnoseId}
